name: Villager Workstation Highlights
summary: Shows where a villager's job site (workstation) is. Stand next to a villager and run /trigger vwh_findStation.

mechanics.title: How it works
mechanics.description: The nearest villager within 5 blocks of you glows for 10 seconds, a heart-particle cloud appears above its workstation for about 10 seconds, and chat shows 'The workstation is located at [XYZ]: x y z'. If it has none: 'This villager does not have a workstation!'.

qol: Find which block a villager claimed, which helps fix trading halls.
commands_and_keybinds: /trigger vwh_findStation : locate the workstation of the nearest villager (within 5 blocks)
getting_started: Stand within 5 blocks of a villager and type /trigger vwh_findStation.
editor_notes: Reads the villager's job_site memory only. It picks the nearest villager, not the one you look at.
